name: Five-Round Symmetry Demo
description: Five staged layout prompts used for baseline/evolution demo comparisons.
queries: Build a scene in which six trees are arranged in a bilateral layout, and place three lighthouses in the center so that they form a triangle.
Create houses with longitudinal symmetry, and arrange five trees on the outer side so that they form a pentagonal landmark.
Design a neighborhood of four buildings in which the left and right halves are symmetrical, and place six trees at the center forming a hexagon.
Build a scene with buildings and trees in which the buildings are symmetrically aligned and the trees surround them in a circular pattern.

Produce a large-scale composition: maintain a bilateral master layout of buildings, create a central Baguazhen pattern using trees along with any additional visually compelling assets, and ensure the ground area is large enough for the entire design to be fully grounded.
